'''Sona Lerenga''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] serving aboard the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] [[Far*Reach IV PQR]] ''[[Wanderer]]'' at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of its crash on the [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Isis/Legends|Isis]].

==Biography==
A swarthy looking rogue, Lerenga was forced to settle for a career in the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] rather than the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], after his father publicly embarrassed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

==Personality and traits==
Lerenga displayed outlandish behavior, often taking silly chances just for the thrill of it, to compensate for having his ambitions frustrated.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Isis Coordinates]]'' {{1st}}
